definitions.full: H3523. kabir [ כָּבִיר ] noun [masculine] probably something netted , i.e. either a quilt or (Ew H. 8. 77 Ke) a fly-net ( κωνωπεῖον ) spread over the face while a person was asleep; 1Sam 19:13 , 16 הָעִזִּים כְּבִיר a quilt (or fly-net ) of goats (' hair). See further Dr on the passage
definitions.rootNote: from 3527 in the original sense of plaiting;

occurrences.englishText: Michal took the teraphim,* teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property. and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head, and covered it with clothes.
When the messengers came in, behold, the teraphim was in the bed, with the pillow of goats’ hair at its head.
